title: Neural Surrogate Modeling of Ultrasonic Wave Propagation in Heterogeneous Media
abstract: arXiv:2610.13258v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural surrogates provide computationally efficient auto-regressive modeling of wave propagation, enabling e.g. fast inverse solutions. Despite recent progress, the current surrogates are not yet sufficient for the needs of ultrasonic sensing, characterized by high frequency and heterogeneous propagation media. We show how methods building on Fourier Neural Operators (FNO) fail to capture essential signal features, such as reflections, whereas U-Net -based methods learn the wave fields well but lack the ability to transfer information across different spatial scales. We then propose a new surrogate that captures the best of the two worlds, by integrating FNOs and local-integral resampling into a U-Net architecture. We show it can be trained on limited data, and that the predictions are robust to input noise and work across spatial scales.

translated_title: 非均匀介质中超声波传播的神经代理模型
translated_abstract: 神经代理模型为波传播提供了计算高效的自回归建模，可实现诸如快速逆问题求解等应用。尽管近来已有进展，但现有的代理模型仍无法满足超声传感的需求，而超声传感的特点正是高频和非均匀的传播介质。我们展示了基于傅里叶神经算子的方法如何无法捕捉重要的信号特征（如反射），而基于U-Net的方法虽然能很好地学习波场，却缺乏在不同空间尺度之间传递信息的能力。随后，我们提出了一种新的代理模型，通过将FNO与局部积分重采样整合到U-Net架构中，兼取两者之长。我们证明该模型可以在有限数据上完成训练，其预测对输入噪声具有鲁棒性，并能在不同空间尺度上有效工作。
tldr: 提出了一种将傅里叶神经算子与局部积分重采样融入U-Net架构的新型神经代理模型，能够在有限数据下高效、鲁棒地模拟非均匀介质中的高频超声波传播，并适用于不同空间尺度。
en_tdlr: A novel neural surrogate integrating Fourier Neural Operators and local-integral resampling into a U-Net architecture robustly and efficiently models high-frequency ultrasonic wave propagation in heterogeneous media across spatial scales with limited training data.
